sections.heading: Destination Snapshot
sections.body: Monobloc Reus is an indoor climbing centre in Reus, not an outdoor rock destination. It is useful for training days, bad-weather sessions and visitors passing through Catalonia.
warnings: No sufficiently specific sourced content for Destination Snapshot.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
Monobloc Reus is a bouldering-focused urban climbing centre at Carrer de Sabadell, 24 in Reus. The Reus centre also has a rope area.

Treat it as an indoor training option rather than a destination guide to natural rock. It is useful for visitors passing through Catalonia, but it is not a crag page.

sections.heading: Who It Suits
sections.body: The centre is suitable for indoor bouldering sessions, first visits and training days. Children can climb at Reus from age four, with supervision requirements for minors.

sections.heading: Season
sections.body: As an indoor centre, Monobloc Reus is a year-round climbing option. Opening hours and pricing should be checked directly before a visit.

sections.heading: Gear
sections.body: Bring comfortable sports clothing. Climbing shoes and liquid chalk are required, with rental or shop options available at the centre.

sections.body: The address is Carrer de Sabadell, 24, 43204 Reus. Treat transport as urban access rather than crag access.

sections.body: Normal indoor bouldering rules apply: use the mats properly, follow the centre rules and complete the required first-visit paperwork. Minors need the appropriate adult authorization and supervision.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.body:
Is this an outdoor destination? No. It is an indoor climbing centre.

Is there rope climbing? The Reus centre has a rope area alongside bouldering.

Is it a normal crag page? No. Treat it as an indoor training option.
